text: Wacoal Corp. is a full subsidiary of Wacoal Holdings Corporation: on 1 October 2005 Wacoal moved to a holding-company structure, and the newly established Wacoal Corp. became a full subsidiary of Wacoal Holdings Corporation.
short: Wacoal Corp. has been a full subsidiary of Wacoal Holdings Corp. since 2005.
